mapper.sql: select s.schedule_id, s.user_id, u.login_name, u.user_name, s.dept_id, d.dept_name, s.work_date, s.schedule_month, s.shift_id, sh.shift_name, s.rest_type, s.generate_source, s.manual_modified, s.schedule_remark, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time from hr_schedule s left join sys_user u on u.user_id = s.user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = s.dept_id left join hr_shift sh on sh.shift_id = s.shift_id
mapper.insert: insert into hr_schedule( user_id, dept_id, work_date, schedule_month, shift_id, rest_type, generate_source, manual_modified, schedule_remark, create_by, create_time ) values( #{userId}, #{deptId}, #{workDate}, #{scheduleMonth}, #{shiftId}, #{restType}, #{generateSource}, #{manualModified}, #{scheduleRemark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
